title: MacroForge
description: A Neoforge Optimization modpack for every PC [1.21.5 and up]
body:
**MacroForge** gives immediate performance for users who just want vanilla Minecraft.\
We also include ***Iris for you***, for you to enjoy the amazing looks of Minecraft while having the best FPS MacroForge can possibly do.

**Need A Performance Modpack For Fabric? Try NanoFabric For A Test!**

[![ModDex rating](https://moddex.gg/badges/projects/macroforge/rating.svg?style=banner)](https://moddex.gg/modpack/macroforge)

### What's The Benefit Of This Modpack?

🗲 Absolute Max Performance, meaning we try to choose the best mods for FPS, stability, culling, network and rendering optimizations.

🪽 Lightweight, this modpack was meant to be lightweight for everyone.

∞ Fully Customizable, this means you can add the QoL mods, resource packs, and datapacks that you want.

× No QoL mods, No mods that effect the Terrain, No mods that add entities nor mechanics. All vanilla.
___

### Who does the testing for MacroForge?

Me, **Forlorn** does the main testing and what mods enter or leaves.

**Forlorns Pc's Specs Are**
- GeForce RTX 3050 "Type of GPU: Dedicated GPU", 
- Intel Core i5-8500, 
- 16 GB of DDR4 RAM, 4 GB is used for Minecraft, 
- Type of Pc: Tower PC

<details>
<summary>Answers For The Concerns That May Occur</summary>

# Concerns that may occur

Simple Questions
---
1. **Will this improve FPS massively?**\
   **Yes**, **MacroForge** is focused on massively improving performance, from doing stability increase to FPS increase. For Low to High end PC's users to enjoy.

2. **Will it update to the newest version?**\
   **Yes**. I'll try and make MacroForge update to the newest version of Minecraft for you to play. But it is a side project from my main project which is **NanoFabric**

3. **Will it have Iris?**\
   **Mostly yes**, our older versions of MacroForge should have Iris shaders, but with Sodium updating sometimes it'll take them longer to update, but I'll try my best.

Safety Questions
---

3. **Is this safe to use?**\
   **Yes**, all of these mods was tested and reviewed to see if its safe or not, if they weren't safe, then they would be removed and **will never** be added to MacroForge even if they claimed that they stopped, they already broke our trust.

4. **Will it work with other mods?**\
   **Yes**. Sodium and the rest of the mods in this list was made to give great performance and great compatibility.

5. **Will this break Multiplayer servers?**\
   **No**, **MacroForge** will not break your multiplayer servers.

Vanilla Minecraft Concern Questions
---

6. **Will it kill the vanilla feeling?**\
   **No**, **MacroForge** was made to make the vanilla Minecraft intact and will **NOT** remove the vanilla feel but instead, just performance to make it feel smoother.

7. **Will this change gameplay or add new features?**\
   **No**, like before this is just a performance modpack that will **NOT ADD** any new mechanics nor items in Minecraft, this was only made for you to enjoy the performance and game on vanilla Minecraft.

Other Possible Questions
---

8. **Do I need to configure anything?**\
    **No**, it was made to be ready out of the box, but you can change it in your needs for performance.

9. **Can I add/remove mods in the Modpack?**\
    **Absolutely**, you may add/remove any mods you want in **MacroForge**, from what you want and need for your Minecraft worlds but if you remove/swap some performance mod it may decrease your FPS or stability.

</details>
